newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Air names Dempsey vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Air names Dempsey vice chairman.

text.p: Frontier Airlines Inc said Monday Paul Stephen Dempsey has been elected vice chairman of its board of directors, a newly created position.
Dempsey, 46, has served as a member of the Frontier board since the Denver-based carrier commenced flight operations in July 1994.

The five-member panel, chaired by B. LaRae Orullian, has four outside directors including Dempsey, a professor of law and a director of the Transportation Law Program at the University of Denver. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
